ui.ask_only_title: Show only the prompts you sent, hide assistant replies
ui.expand_all_title: Expand or collapse all reasoning and tool calls
ui.info_idle: Open a session to see its full details
ui.search_all_ph: Search everything (messages, reasoning, tool output, attachment names)…

Work report: takes only the prompts you sent, groups them by day into date: … / task N: …, filters auto-continue prompts and duplicates, and keeps main sessions only. Review it before you use it.

ui.searching: Searching (the first run builds the index)…
ui.search_hint: Type a keyword to start searching
ui.hits_summary: {count} hits, showing the first {shown} · index has {indexed} parts
ui.name: Name
ui.export_big: This session has {parts} parts. Exporting without a date range produces a very large file. Limit the range first (for example the last week).
ui.export_hint: For long sessions, export by date range.
ui.title: Title
ui.child_sessions_hint: Each child session is a separate conversation containing the subagent's full investigation; the main session only keeps the task call and its summary. Click one to open it.
ui.todos_hint: The last todo list this session rendered. Only the latest state is kept; there is no history.
tool.search.description: Search the local OpenCode session database across messages, reasoning, tool output and attachment names. Returns matching sessions, timestamps, part kinds and context snippets. The first search builds an index and can be slow.
tool.search.query: Keyword or phrase (CJK terms of 3+ characters use the index; shorter terms fall back to fuzzy matching)
tool.search.session_id: Restrict to one session, e.g. ses_xxx
tool.search.kinds: Comma-separated part kinds: text, reasoning, tool, file
tool.search.hint: Use the session ID and timestamp to jump straight to that spot with session_explorer.
tool.report.description: Collect the prompts you sent in a date range into a "date: … / task N: …" work report and save it as Markdown. Useful for weekly reports and work logs. Auto-continue prompts and duplicates are filtered out; main sessions only by default.
tool.report.to: End date, YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today
tool.explorer.description: Open the graphical OpenCode session explorer (local web page) with session filtering, jump-by-day, newest-first paging, questions-only view, full-text search with jump-to-hit, stats, export and work report generation.
tool.explorer.session_id: Optional: open a specific session, e.g. ses_xxx
tool.explorer.start_failed: The local session service did not start. Run `npx opencode-session-explorer` (or `python3 src/py/server.py`) and try again.
tool.error.bad_token: Access token rejected. Check the token in {path}.
server.report_note: Note: entries are collected from your own prompts and grouped by date, with auto-continue prompts and duplicates removed. Review before use.
server.login_sub: This local service has an access token enabled. Enter the token to continue.
server.login_note:
The token lives in config.json under token.
To disable it, clear that field and restart, or run python server.py --no-token.
server.login_too_many: Too many attempts. Try again later.
server.config_note: Leave token empty to disable. When set, sign in at http://127.0.0.1:{port}/login (the token is the password).
